article.title: Tu
article.part: Pronombres y referencia pronominal — Pronomes e referência pronominal
article.chapter: Pronombres personales y formas de tratamiento — Pronomes pessoais e formas de tratamento

claims.summary: Introduces the pronoun 'tu' as the second person singular pronoun used to address one person.

claims.sectionKey: En Brasil, su uso y su concordancia varían mucho según la región y la comunidad.
claims.summary: Mentions that the usage and concordance of 'tu' vary greatly in Brazil depending on the region and community.

claims.sectionKey: En la norma tradicional, tu se combina con formas de segunda persona singular: tu sabes, tu tens, tu és.
claims.summary: Describes the traditional pattern of 'tu' combining with second person singular verb forms.

claims.sectionKey: En diversas regiones brasileñas es frecuente tu con formas verbales de tercera persona: tu sabe, tu tem, tu vai.
claims.summary: Describes the regional and colloquial use of 'tu' with third person verb forms.

claims.sectionKey: Después de preposición suele aparecer ti: para ti, de ti, y la forma contraída contigo corresponde a «con vos/contigo» según el español usado como referencia.
claims.summary: Explains the usage of 'ti' after prepositions and the contraction 'contigo' as 'con vos/contigo' in Spanish.

links.notes: The article states 'Tu es un pronombre personal de segunda persona singular' which directly corresponds to the claim about 'tu' being the second person singular pronoun.
The article explicitly states the variation of 'tu' usage in Brazil, which aligns with the claim.
The source explicitly mentions the traditional pattern of 'tu' with second person singular verb forms, supporting the normative claim.
The source provides evidence of the regional and colloquial use of 'tu' with third person verb forms, supporting the regional variation claim.
The source provides information about the usage of 'ti' after prepositions and the contraction 'contigo', supporting the orthography claim.
